ul.li: the CA public key is fetched once; tokens verify offline at the PEP
the first authentication is sent synchronously, otherwise the very first decision would see trust 0
denies are never cached; allows are cached with TTL, policy version and revocation epoch
the upstream trusts X-ZTC-Subject only because the network lets nothing but the PEP reach it (TB2)
